profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Developer located in Cleveland, Ohio

Core Technologies: Java, Spring MVC, Python, JQuery, Subversion, GIT, SQLServer, MySQL, Oracle DB

Other Areas: Jenkins, Maven, JUnit, JMeter, Avalanche, Oracle ATG

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Provide coding for new features and maintenance to the java code. Provide support for customer facing issues with a third party software. Also provide support for background supporting systems with multiple languages and technologies.

positions.title: Student Clerk
positions.description: Provided staff support within the Ethnic Studies department. Responsibilities included helping with technology support within the department, submitting book orders to publishers, answering and forwarding phone calls, sorting and sending mail and assisting staff members with projects. A project to convert all department VHS tapes to DVD was established and continued after I left due to graduation.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Maintaining and building the club website while also moving the club to a more digital environment for current manual and paper practices. 

Developed a large coverage indoor / outdoor wifi and managed network for the club grounds. Using PtMP connections and mesh technologies, members are able to use internet in the clubhouse and their boats.

Installed and maintain the digital security system including remote cameras using PtMP.

Manage the fleet of member boats which includes keeping accurate documentation of boats, registration, member information and boat locations. Other duites include helping run meetings, assignment of docks and other items requested by the Commodore.

projects.title: Cardstore.com
projects.description: A high volume / high traffic e-commerce platform where you can design your own custom Christmas cards & greeting cards and personalize your message & photo for said cards for a personal touch.
